subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be scoped to documenting the existing TUI multiline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a supported standalone TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already gets basic Shift+Enter newline behavior from pi-tui, but adding a configurable send/newline preference would expand OpenClaw's public config/keybinding surface under a policy that keeps config additions intentionally high-bar.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` to describe Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior without adding a new config surface yet.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Wire a supported TUI keybinding configuration path into standalone `openclaw tui`, including docs, help text, and upgrade-safe tests.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Composer Work
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical TUI shortcut request while coordinating with external editor and vim-mode issues before choosing a permanent keybinding model.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update `docs/web/tui.md` and `/help` to describe Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior without adding a new config surface yet.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the only clear routing candidate from current-main TUI blame and the prior maintainer review on this issue.
